title: The Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, let $\mathfrak U=\{U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering, and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C$. There is a convergent first-quadrant spectral sequence

$$
E_2^{p,q}=\check H^p(\mathfrak U,\underline H^q(F))\Longrightarrow H^{p+q}(X,F),
$$

where $\underline H^q(F)$ is the presheaf $V\mapsto H^q(V,F)$ and $\check H^p(\mathfrak U,-)$ is Cech cohomology with respect to the covering $\mathfrak U$.

proof.text: Construct a suitable derived-section model and Cech bicomplex on the large site in the independent coefficient/index universe. This step is unresolved under HasExt alone. The repaired equal-universe helper assumes EnoughInjectives and therefore cannot be used here without additional justified theory.
Apply the first double-complex spectral sequence, compose its E2 isomorphisms with homology of the column isomorphisms, and transport the abutment along the total homology isomorphisms.
